meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 告訴；把消息、資訊或事情說給某人聽；講述故事或經歷

primaryExample.sentenceEn: She told me the news after lunch.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 她午餐後把消息告訴了我。

primaryExample.sentenceEn: The teacher told us to close our books.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 老師叫我們把書合起來。

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 辨別差異；看出或判斷某種情況或事實

primaryExample.sentenceEn: Can you tell the twins apart?
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 你分得出這對雙胞胎嗎？

secondaryExamples.sentenceEn: I could tell she was tired.

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 顯示；透露某種狀況或事實

primaryExample.sentenceEn: The look on his face told me he was worried.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 他臉上的表情讓我看出他很擔心。

primaryExample.sentenceEn: My daughter can tell the time now.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 我女兒現在會看鐘錶了。

meaningLines.meaningZhHant: 在 tell someone off 中表示斥責、責備某人

primaryExample.sentenceEn: The coach told him off for arriving late.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 他遲到，被教練斥責了一頓。

coreMeaningZhHant: 把事情說給別人知道；也可表示吩咐、辨別或顯示。

examples.sentenceEn: My brother told on me for taking the cookies.
examples.translationZhHant: 我哥哥告我的狀，說我拿了餅乾。

headwordExpressions.meaningZhHant: 告某人的狀；向他人揭發某人的不當行為

examples.sentenceEn: Only time will tell whether the plan works.
examples.translationZhHant: 這個計畫能不能成功，只有時間能證明。

headwordExpressions.meaningZhHant: 時間會證明；結果如何，以後才會知道

mainExample.sentenceEn: She told me the news after lunch.
mainExample.translationZhHant: 她午餐後把消息告訴了我。

meaningSummary.meaningZhHant: 告訴；講述；吩咐；辨別；看出；顯示；看時間；斥責（tell off）

wordFamily.meaningZhHant: 透露實情的；有說服力的；有顯著效果的
